text: This report submits the 2022-2031 Capital Budget of the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo. The Policy and Finance Committee reviewed the 2022-2031 Capital Budget on August 25, 2021 and recommended it for approval by the Board.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the 2022-2031 Capital Budget as shown in Schedule I to the report (September 20, 2021) from the Director, Finance and Technology, Toronto Zoo.
